title: Chapter 576
paragraphs: Chapter 576
Episode 149. Highran's Light, or (1)
About a month had passed since the end of the war.
Now, even those who had not directly witnessed the Sword Emperor's Palace and the subjugation of Gliack knew what had happened in the world.

The fact that the emperor had driven the pillar of the empire to treason, the identity of the white stone, and the results of all these events were still being reported non-stop by news outlets of various factions.
In the end, Ron Highran succeeded in blocking the last explosion of chaos by himself.

However, dealing with the chaos that had already penetrated his protective barrier and the aftermath of the self-destruction during his battle with Gliack was an impossible task, even for him who had ascended to Changseong.
As everyone on the battlefield had feared.
The chaos that escaped the protective barrier was turning parts of the world into uninhabitable lands.
"What a crazy, never-ending situation. Are these really just remnants of that monster, the king of chaos or whatever?"
Daytona and Heitona.
The two were currently on a mission to suppress the 'remnants of chaos' that had fallen near the Delki Kingdom.
The faces of the brothers and the Guardian Knights they led showed signs of exhaustion. They had been working around the clock for several days.
The monsters dubbed as remnants of chaos were being generated from the lands across the world where Gliack's chaos had fallen.

Delki was just one of them. So far, about fifty "contaminated areas" had been discovered, and the number was increasing every day. It was unknown how many undiscovered contaminated areas there might be.
If Ron had failed to handle Gliack's self-destruction, if he had achieved Changseong with a different attribute rather than protection.
The world would have been irreversibly destroyed.
"What kind of monster did the people on that battlefield fight against?"
"It must have been a horrible creature, one that would render people like us completely meaningless. Since the monsters that are just remnants are already like this."
Heitona answered as he carved out a piece of the monster's body.
The monsters in the contaminated areas had a vitality that was incomparable to any known demonic beasts in the world.
When their bodies were torn apart, they multiplied by the number of pieces, only stopping when they were broken down into tiny bits of flesh, almost the size of a bean.
Among them were individuals with rapid regeneration abilities instead of multiplication. They belonged to a particularly strong group, and the monsters in the contaminated areas were all unique.
The strongest known individual was reported to require the power of a Black Knight level to be subdued.

Their habits and tendencies were also completely different from ordinary demonic beasts. They were specialized in parasitism rather than combat, and they used living creatures, including humans, as hosts.
And the host organisms were infectious, and humans attacked by such entities showed signs of being consumed by chaos and running wild.

Fortunately, not all humans were susceptible to the infection. Well-trained warriors and mages showed a significant level of immunity. The Tona brothers didn't even want to imagine what would have happened if that hadn't been the case.
The magical society named it 'Infectious Chaos'.
In essence, the world was experiencing a great disaster. A disaster no less significant than the largest ones known to have been caused by Helrum.
Not only the Tona brothers, but all members of various factions, including Ziphil, were suppressing chaos worldwide.

"Even now it's terrible, but if our eldest brother Diphus, and Hwaryong Kadun from Ziphil hadn't chosen to suppress it quickly, things would have been worse. Damn, it gives me the chills. Yet our family suffered such a big blow for the first time since the Kingdom's Defense War 500 years ago."
"Not only our family but it's the first time for the whole world, and it's lucky that Ziphil also suffered such damage..."
Runkandel and Ziphil.
Excluding the empire, these two families were undoubtedly the ones that suffered the most damage in this war.
Runkandel lost nearly three hundred elite knights including five black knights, and Rosa was seriously injured.
Ziphil had Kelliak seriously injured, lost the entire 1st and 2nd fleets including Cozec, and lost more than thirty dragons and over five hundred wizards.
The aftermath of the final explosion was particularly problematic.
Gliack's self-destruction lasted a full three days. The forces of each faction could only escape the battlefield two days after the start of the unprecedented explosion.
The current strength of the remaining two factions was not even comparable to that of a single family a month ago.
And of course, the injuries suffered by Rosa and Kelliak were generally unhealable. This was because it was the power of chaos that had caused their serious injuries.
"10th and 11th generation, a message just came from the headquarters."
A Guardian Knight approached the Tona brothers.
"Report."
The Tona brothers' eyes widened as they heard the Guardian Knight's report.
"...So, it has been decided that way."
"If we want to make the date, we need to hurry up."
Without even the time to shake off the monster's flesh from their bodies, the brothers moved deeper into the contaminated area.
Feeling the strange power that had begun to emerge within them since the end of the war.
"A ceasefire with Ziphil has been decided."
At Rosa's words, Diphus nodded as if he had expected it.
A black spot was visible on Rosa's wrist exposed between her sleeves. When Diphus's gaze fell on it, Rosa naturally covered her wrist.
"It's because of Kinsello."

"Yes. They are the only ones who didn't suffer any damage in this war. They probably watched the war, hoping that our power and Zipple's would weaken from the start, and the result is just as they wanted."
Rosa, suppressing her cough, recalled the last moments of the war.
The sight of her knights and Zipple's wizards being swept away by that terrifying explosion and... the moment when Zipple's magic stone was broken.
'With the magic stone destroyed, it will be impossible for Zipple to recover their power in a short time.'
If the Shilon was in the family, this would be the perfect opportunity to end the thousand-year war in victory.
However, the Black Knights who were sent to the Black Sea at the beginning of the war returned to the family without being able to contact Shilon.
Therefore, conversely, it was also the best time for Zipple to strike Runecandle, but they were in a situation where they couldn't afford to take risks with Kinsello as a common enemy.
Recovering the magic stone was Zipple's top priority. It was for the recovery of their power, but the real reason was different.
"Mother. As you may know, something strange has been happening to the purebloods, including me."
What Diffuse was referring to as strange was the power that the Tona brothers had felt.
"Do you mean you've started to feel magical power?"
Magic.
Since the end of the war, all purebloods of Runecandle, except for Jin, were feeling magical power for the first time since their birth.
Rosa couldn't feel that sensation, but she was aware that the magical power her children had was still extremely weak.
As a result of the magic stone being destroyed and Zipple taking a huge blow.
The power of the story, Zipple's magic that manipulates history, was weakening. Therefore, the oath and curse from a thousand years ago that were suppressing Runecandle were also becoming unstable.
That's why Kelliac suggested a ceasefire so urgently. Rosa had no choice but to agree, knowing that fact.
"What should we do?"
"If you're asking whether we need to hide and be wary, we don't."
Diffuse looked at Rosa with surprise.

"Why are you so surprised? It's a fact already told to everyone by the youngest, that our family originally had the power of magic swords. The current phenomenon is due to Zipple's power weakening and the curse they placed on the family fading."
"If they recover their power, we'll be back to square one."
"Not everyone who can handle magic will be able to do so like the youngest. Besides, unless Zipple is completely destroyed, that power will remain unusable."
Rosa decided that there was no point in finding a way to use the weak magic immediately.
She thought that only after Zipple was completely defeated and the family's curse truly ended, could they regain their position as magic swordsmen.
"There will be no time for the generations to do personal training until the chaos is sufficiently suppressed. Keep your minds clear and focus on cleaning up the contaminated areas."
Diffuse bowed his head.
"And, is the 12th generation still there?"
"Yes."
When Glieck's suicide bombing continued for three days, Jin and Dante did not suffer any additional damage even in the storm of chaos. It was because Ron's will intensively guarded the two.
Currently, the land where the Sword Emperor Castle was located is more seriously contaminated than any other place in the world where fragments of chaos have flown.
For the past month, those who were in charge of the chaos suppression mission of each force have not even started the purification of the Sword Emperor Castle.
They just tied up the chaos that was still fluctuating inside the territory after hitting Jin.
The moment Rosa was about to say something, a guardian knight urgently found their office.
"Acting Family Head! Two hours ago, there is a report that the 12th generation entered the inner territory of the Sword Emperor Castle...!"
"What!?"
Diphus shouted.
Like Rosa and Kelriak, Jin is also not completely finished with the erosion of chaos.

And since it has already been revealed that those who are eroded by chaos react to greater chaos and advance demonization, entering the territory of the Sword Emperor Castle was no different from suicide.
"Mother, I will go and see for myself......"
"No, there's no need for that."
Rosa said in a calm voice.
"He must have confidence that something will protect him. If the youngest fell into demonization and entered the territory, more unusual things would have been reported. Like attacking allies."
What is it that protects the youngest?
Diphus couldn't ask that question in Rosa's bitter eyes.
At that time, Jin was not the only one who entered the territory of the Sword Emperor Castle.
There was one person who entered the territory, which became a hell of chaos, earlier than him. And the two, as Rosa expected, walked on the contaminated land with the help of some power.
The two, not anyone else, received protection that only they could enjoy.
"Dante."
Looking at his friend's back, Jin called his name.
"Jin."
Dante did not look back at Jin. Jin sat next to Dante and moved his gaze to where Dante was looking.
Through the chaotic wind that wraps around the entire territory, only one point they were looking up was emitting bright light.
That one chunk of light.
The light, which was a person, protected the two from the chaos of the polluted land.
"This was not the end of you and me, so don't linger in sorrow for too long, I guess this is what Grandfather meant......"
Jin, without seeing Dante's crying, comforted his back for a long time.
